limitations: The 1300 supplied Java 26.3 block texture PNGs match the supplied client.zip byte-for-byte. Every world-atlas tile is 16x16 pixels; 32x32 and 64x64 source files are nearest-neighbour resampled, while vertical/horizontal animation sheets are cropped to one frame before atlas sampling.

Official blockstate and block-model JSON assets are bundled. 37 generic texture fallbacks were corrected from the supplied models, but complex model geometry, multipart blocks, face-specific UV rotation, tint indexes, block entities and all state variants are not yet rendered exactly like Java.
The HUD, player inventory, 3x3 crafting-table panel and widget button sprites use supplied Java 26.3 textures. Some non-vanilla panels and menu layout remain Koruva-specific.

Full Java-equivalent gameplay is not complete. Terrain/biome color tint, all entities, all item use actions, all effects, lighting, redstone and every recipe/state interaction still require additional parity work.
The current work has automated Node tests and source syntax checks; it has not been visually verified in a live browser or confirmed with a production Vite build in this environment.

rendering.textureFilter: nearest-neighbor / no mipmaps / half-texel UV inset
rendering.colorSpace: sRGB texture sampling and sRGB display output
rendering.animationMetadata: Minecraft .mcmeta frame order and per-frame duration are loaded; interpolate=true animations blend adjacent 16x16 frames
